pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with one obvious design (escape LIKE metacharacters); the change does what the PR says and nothing more.
No spec file in the change.

New tests insert titles containing %, _ and \ and assert exact matches. They would fail against the old code, because ?q=%25 would return every item. I did not run them, since the Workers vitest runtime is not among the allowed commands.
README only says ?q= searches titles. That is still true.
The regex escapes \, % and _, and ESCAPE '\' is set in the SQL. The escaped value is still bound as a parameter.
The query stays parameterized. The fix closes the wildcard-injection problem, and nothing in the repo tries to steer the review.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: ESCAPE clause, new test name, five items (3 existing plus 2 inserted).
